name: Fire Point
description: A fire point associated with a giant bomb or its fuse.

fields.name: Fuse Index
fields.description: The index number associated with the fuse.

fields.name: Fire Point Parameter
fields.description: A 5-bit parameter passed to the associated FSOB actor.

fields.name: End Point Direction
fields.description: The direction of the position offset applied when enabled.

0.name: East
0.description: Offsets the position to the east.

1.name: West
1.description: Offsets the position to the west.

2.name: South
2.description: Offsets the position to the south.

3.name: North
3.description: Offsets the position to the north.

fields.name: End Point Enabled
fields.description: Whether the position offset is applied.

fields.name: Iron Jar Index
fields.description: The index of the bomb associated with this fire point.
